summary: NOVONIX filed a 6-K attaching an ASX announcement disclosing an Amortisation Event under its July 2025 convertible debenture funding agreement with YA II PN, Ltd (Yorkville Advisors). Because the daily VWAP fell below the A$0.12 Floor Price, the company must redeem 20% of the US$35 million outstanding, paying US$7 million in cash by 21 September 2026, reducing the balance to US$28 million, funded from existing cash reserves. Rolling 30-day amortisation payments continue while the trigger persists. This is a routine financing-mechanics disclosure, not a special situation. Watch for further amortisation notices.
